title: Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A classic Turkish dish, these lamb kebabs are marinated in a blend of spices and grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim any excess fat

ingredients.name: Turkish olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use 1 clove if you're not a big fan of garlic

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: Ground cumin adds a nice depth of flavor

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika adds a nice smokiness

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until they're evenly coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they're cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as grilled vegetables or a salad.
